name: Abe no Masahiro
source: Masahiro is the protagonist in the series. He is an Onmyouji in training and the grandson of the legendary Abe no Seimei. When he was young, Masahiro’s spiritual sight was so strong that Seimei temporarily sealed it away until he was old enough to properly use it. After meeting Mokkun, Masahiro regained his spirit sight and embraced his destiny as an Onmyouji in service to the emperor.
